primer: Macpower CNC Machines Limited (NSE: MACPOWER) is a debt-light, promoter-led (73.22% holding) Rajkot CNC machine-tool manufacturer generating 29% ROCE, 16%+ operating margins, and a record ₹476.7 Cr order book (40% NEXA). However, at ₹2,080.00 (48.40x TTM P/E, 10.57x P/B, >600x FY26 FCF) and 259 inventory days, Reverse DCF prices in ~22–24% 7-year revenue CAGR with zero cyclicality. With Base Target ₹2,280 (+9.6%) versus ₹1,548–₹1,675 structural risk (-19.5% to -25.6%), near-support asymmetry is ~0.49:1 (<1.50:1 hurdle). Verdict: REJECTED (TIER_0) for new capital; NOT_HELD; set alert for ₹1,550–₹1,680.
